acceptance: Packaged MV3 extension (background 7616 B, content 9530 B, WASM 1004635 B, deterministic id) snapshots only the user-authorized fixture origin; ungranted same-host origin and browser-denied foreign host stay unobserved.

negative.fixture: same-host other port (no VSF grant), different host (no browser permission)

security_and_source_permissions: Only user-authorized origins are observed; form values and secret-shaped text never leave the page; no source application server is contacted; bridge and extension commands are origin- and sender-checked.
performance_memory_storage: capture of the forms page to verified digest: see bench/capture.json (1k nodes p50 31 ms end to end)
known_limitations: Authorization prompt path (permissions.request with a user gesture) is not automated; product build requests host access at runtime and is verified manually in B09
